summary: The Design Controls' Channel Street open space: a pedestrian gateway with 10 ft active edges along Blocks B and C, a plaza up to 50 ft wide with a 12 ft minimum pedestrian throughway, and a tree grove between the plaza and the Shared Public Way. Recorded as planned: no source read says it has been built, and the Port's June 2026 report describes Phase 2 as not yet begun.

milestones.text: Final Design Controls (document dated April 24, 2018) defines Channel Street as a dedicated open space (Section 3.7)

Phase 1 submittal says several streets 'will be given interim treatments (Bridgeview Street and Channel Street)' and lists two interim pedestrian plazas south of Parcels B and F; it does not say either is this lot

facts.value: 10 ft active edges along Blocks B and C; a plaza of 50 ft maximum width with a 12 ft minimum pedestrian throughway; a tree grove with a 12 ft minimum pedestrian throughway between the plaza and the Shared Public Way

sources.title: Mission Rock Design Controls, April 24, 2018 (final; Section 3 open spaces, Figure 3.1.1)
